entries.value: 在设计器中显示/隐藏零件

entries.key: Tip: Several parts have properties that can be set by clicking the button with the wrench icon.
entries.value: 提示：不少零件都有可以设置的属性，点击带扳手图标的按钮即可打开。

entries.key: Toggles the foam on the water surface including foam effects caused by player crafts and other objects in the scene. This looks good but does have a negative impact on performance.
entries.value: 切换水面的泡沫效果，包括玩家载具与场景中其他物体产生的泡沫。效果好看，但确实会对性能造成负面影响。

entries.key: Toggles the waves along the shorelines. This has an impact on performance but also, some players may just prefer less turbulent shorelines, either for physics-related or visual reasons.
entries.value: 切换岸线附近的波浪。这会影响性能，而且有些玩家可能更喜欢不那么汹涌的岸线——无论是出于物理表现还是视觉偏好。

entries.key: Weld the selected parts so they to move together in the designer. Does not make them rigid in flight.
entries.value: 焊接所选零件，使它们在设计器中一起移动。不会让它们在飞行中变成刚体。
